title: Create root and nested Part Categories with valid parameters
scenarioDescription: Verify that an authenticated user can create both root-level (parent: null) and hierarchically nested part categories via POST /api/part/category/, receiving HTTP 201 Created and properly populated pathstrings.

title: Category creation validation constraints and duplicate name rejection
scenarioDescription: Verify that category creation enforces mandatory name, maximum 100 character length, and rejects duplicate category names under the same parent scope with HTTP 400 Bad Request.

title: Category list retrieval with parent hierarchy filtering and sorting
scenarioDescription: Verify that GET /api/part/category/ supports filtering by parent ID (direct children only), parent=null (root categories only), and deterministic sorting by name.

title: Category detail retrieval with accurate pathstring and part count
scenarioDescription: Verify that GET /api/part/category/{id}/ returns HTTP 200 with complete metadata, full breadcrumb pathstring, and live part_count tally.

title: Category detail retrieval with non-existent or invalid primary key
scenarioDescription: Verify that GET /api/part/category/{id}/ returns HTTP 404 Not Found when supplied with an unknown or non-numeric category ID.

title: Category full replacement update via PUT and pathstring propagation
scenarioDescription: Verify that PUT /api/part/category/{id}/ updates category name and description, propagating updated pathstrings to all descendant categories.

title: Circular parent category hierarchy rejection (Cycle Prevention)
scenarioDescription: Verify that attempting to set a category's parent to one of its own descendants is rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request to prevent infinite loops and DAG cycles.

title: Deletion of empty Part Category with zero child parts and categories
scenarioDescription: Verify that DELETE /api/part/category/{id}/ successfully deletes an empty category and returns HTTP 204 No Content.

title: Deletion protection for non-empty Part Category containing parts
scenarioDescription: Verify that DELETE /api/part/category/{id}/ is blocked with HTTP 400 Bad Request when the category still contains assigned parts.

title: Create new Part with valid mandatory attributes and unique IPN
scenarioDescription: Verify that POST /api/part/ creates a new part with valid name, existing category, unique IPN, defaulting active=true and returning HTTP 201 Created.

title: Part creation constraint validation failures
scenarioDescription: Verify that POST /api/part/ rejects missing name, missing category, invalid category ID, and duplicate IPN collisions with HTTP 400 Bad Request.

title: Part catalogue paginated list retrieval and response envelope
scenarioDescription: Verify that GET /api/part/ returns HTTP 200 with count, next, previous, and results array within the 2,000ms latency SLA.

title: Part list pagination boundary and negative parameter handling
scenarioDescription: Verify that negative limit or offset parameters to GET /api/part/ return HTTP 400 Bad Request.

title: Part detail retrieval returning complete entity metadata
scenarioDescription: Verify that GET /api/part/{id}/ returns HTTP 200 with all metadata fields (name, category, IPN, active, flags, units, minimum_stock).

title: Part full replacement update via PUT and boolean defaults
scenarioDescription: Verify that PUT /api/part/{id}/ replaces all fields, defaults omitted boolean flags to false, and rejects missing mandatory fields with HTTP 400.

title: Part partial delta update via PATCH and inactive state toggle
scenarioDescription: Verify that PATCH /api/part/{id}/ modifies only supplied fields, supports empty body no-op, and maintains part readability when active is set to false.

title: Part deletion blocked by active stock or BOM referential constraints
scenarioDescription: Verify that DELETE /api/part/{id}/ returns HTTP 400 Bad Request when the part has active stock items or is referenced in a Bill of Materials.

title: Deletion of clean unreferenced Part entity
scenarioDescription: Verify that DELETE /api/part/{id}/ successfully deletes an unreferenced part with zero stock and zero BOM relations, returning HTTP 204 No Content.

title: Compound multi-facet search and filter conjunction (AND logic)
scenarioDescription: Verify that GET /api/part/?category=<id>&active=true&search=<keyword> applies logical AND conjunction, returning the intersection of all facets within 3,000ms.

title: Search with zero matching results returns empty envelope
scenarioDescription: Verify that GET /api/part/?search=NON_EXISTENT_QUERY returns HTTP 200 OK with results: [] rather than HTTP 404.

title: Mutating endpoints reject unauthenticated requests without token
scenarioDescription: Verify that POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE requests without an Authorization header are rejected with HTTP 401 Unauthorized or HTTP 403 Forbidden.

title: Mutating endpoints reject invalid or expired tokens
scenarioDescription: Verify that mutating requests with malformed, fake, or expired tokens are rejected with HTTP 401 Unauthorized.

title: Category Tree View interactive navigation and list filtering journey
scenarioDescription: Verify via browser automation that navigating the Part Category tree, expanding subcategories, and selecting a category node updates the parts table seamlessly.

title: Create Part modal end-to-end user journey with client validation
scenarioDescription: Verify via browser automation opening the Create Part modal, testing client-side validation on empty inputs, filling valid details, and verifying toast and redirection.
